languageDefinitions.atoms: One explicit ATOM wrapper as defined in atom-contract.json; exact per-row body and parameter contracts. No alternate flattened atom or metadata-only child.

composition.ALL: Nonempty children, all alleged; all independently satisfy their row contract. No metadata-only child.
composition.ANY: Nonempty alternative allegations with complete atoms and explicit separate findings.
composition.NOT: Exactly one complete child and scoped negation; lack of evidence is not negation.
composition.QUALIFIED: Exactly one complete child, appliesToAtomId equal to that child atomId; qualifiers stay on that atom and cannot alter typed target/time/quantity values. Allowed keys epistemicPosture, sourceQuality, extentQualification; any refinement must also be explicit in atom scope.
composition.SEQUENCE: Nonempty complete children and explicit orderRelations {beforeAtomId, afterAtomId, temporalRelation}; relation BEFORE means strict end/instant < start/instant. Never infer time from array position.

languageDefinitions.scope: Every atom binds target/role and its temporal/extent quantifier. PARTIAL extent is not ALL subject; COMPLETED is not merely STARTED/IN_PROGRESS.
languageDefinitions.quantity: quantity-contract.json defines the complete bounded operation quantity collection, material/basis roles, multiplicity and exact original/normalized values. Each row quantity field references an entry in the same activity instance.
languageDefinitions.unknown: UNREPORTED means this parameter is not asserted, not zero, not negative and not inferred from a plan. It is allowed only for optional quantities/qualifications that the row permits; never for subject, activity definition, required temporal source or required evidence/profile rule. It cannot satisfy a criterion requiring the value.
languageDefinitions.qualitativeAndCoded: CODED values require exact property/result concept and revision. QUALITATIVE values require a closed scale with a defined interpretation for the selected predicate; original prose remains evidence, never an opaque executable claim.
languageDefinitions.censored: Preserve result set and censoring/method bounds. Universal truth over the admissible set -> SATISFIED; universal falsehood -> NOT_SATISFIED; mixed/unknown -> INDETERMINATE. No censored-to-zero conversion.
languageDefinitions.epistemic: ALLEGED, SUSPECTED, ESTIMATED and DISPUTED remain distinct qualifications. A confidence label is not probability or measurement precision unless the bound method defines it.
languageDefinitions.extensions: OTHER is a carrier token, not meaning. A new term requires a candidate definition with kind/roles, typed parameters, operators, time/facet, context/evidence predicates, source rationale and positive/contradiction. Adopt through the existing body/pack owners; no caller-defined arbitrary executable predicate.
languageDefinitions.narrative: Preserve original NarrativeObservation, source payloads and lexical evidence immutably. A new typed claim explicitly declares the selected proposition and qualifications before hashing; old text is not overwritten or retroactively declared equivalent.
languageDefinitions.temporalQualifiers: Current canonical qualifier rules remain unchanged; operation-profile-contract.json guards their instant use and defines intended/interval branches.

logicalOutcomeAlgebra.NOT: TRUE from an evaluated FALSE child, FALSE from TRUE, INDETERMINATE from INDETERMINATE. Missing evidence is not evaluated FALSE.
